prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean the Phoenix metro area? And are you looking for a single-tooth implant, multiple implants/full-arch, or an implant dentist who does both placement and the final crown/restoration? If you give your ZIP code and any preferences (specialist vs general dentist, in-network with an insurance plan, sedation needed), I can find several highly rated options near you.

Meanwhile, here’s how to find the “best” provider and what to ask at a consultation:

Which kind of provider to consider
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons (OMS): surgical specialists who place implants and handle complex surgeries (bone grafts, sinus lifts, extractions, sedation).
- Periodontists: gum specialists who commonly place implants and do complex grafting.
- Prosthodontists: experts in restoring teeth (they design and deliver the implant crowns, bridges, or dentures). For full-mouth or complex restorations, include a prosthodontist in the team.
- General dentists with advanced implant training: many are excellent for straightforward cases and can manage both surgery and restoration.

Key credentials and experience to look for
- Board certification or fellowship (ABOMS for surgeons, American Board of Periodontology diplomate, American Board of Prosthodontics).
- Years and volume of implant cases and experience with the type of case you need (single tooth vs full-arch).
- Use of CBCT (3D x-ray) and digital planning/guided surgery.
- Ability to manage complications and perform grafting/sinus lifts if needed.
- Before/after photos and patient references.

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implants like mine do you place per year?
- Will you do the implant placement and crown/restoration, or work as a team?
- What implant brand/system do you use and why?
- Do you use CBCT and guided surgery?
- Will I need bone grafting or a sinus lift? If so, how does that change cost/timeline?
- What is the full cost (surgery, abutment, crown, imaging, follow-ups)? Any payment/financing plans?
- What is your complication rate and how are complications handled?
- Do you offer sedation (nitrous/IV) if I’m anxious?

Where to verify and find providers
- AAID (American Academy of Implant Dentistry) “Find an Implant Dentist”
- American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (find OMS)
- American Academy of Periodontology and American College of Prosthodontists directories
- Local reviews on Google, Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Yelp (read multiple reviews, look for before/after photos)

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether you prefer a specialist or a dentist who handles both placement and restoration, and I’ll pull up several well-rated providers and clinics in Phoenix with short notes on their specialties so you can book consultations.
